about.heading: About These Guitars
paragraphs: This collectible acoustic guitar measures approximately 38 inches in length and features a hand-signed CD cover that has been repurposed as a pickguard and professionally mounted to a real acoustic guitar.

Please note that this is a display and collectible item. While it is a genuine 38-inch acoustic guitar it was not used or played by the featured performer and is not intended to represent a stage-played instrument.

The signature has been authenticated by JSA (James Spence Authentication), one of the world's leading third-party autograph authentication companies. Each guitar includes a tamper-evident JSA authentication hologram affixed to the item, and the autograph can be verified in the JSA online database.
closing: All of our hand-signed autographs are 100% authentic and have been independently verified by a trusted third-party authentication service. Colors of guitars may vary based on availability at the time of order.
CharityWorks is one of the leading suppliers to fundraisers around the USA, of hand-signed guitars.
All items on Consignment. No upfront costs to you or your Charity. If items don't sell you are responsible for the shipping to return.

seo.title: Voucher Program: How It Works & FAQ
seo.description: How the CharityWorks free vacation voucher program works for your donors, with answers to common questions.

travelVoucher.heading: Here's How the Program Works
steps: Voucher is sent to your donor/registrant by your group as an electronic voucher with a link to register.

They are invited to register immediately, but do not have to. Registration is FREE, and it immediately makes them eligible for the ShareLife Travel Discount program (Guaranteed travel savings), as well as the vacations in either Las Vegas or Orlando.
They may begin using the ShareLife Travel program which gives them access to up to 70% off hotel stays immediately. No obligation…No commitment... A GIFT to your donors….
When they are ready to book their first trip ( Vegas or Orlando ), they call in to engage.... and book their dates.
They pick their first FREE destination, Las Vegas or Orlando.
Upon confirmation of their dates, they pay a $100 deposit. This is only to insure that they DO show-up for their reserved dates.
They will get a written email confirmation.

After check-in at their hotel, they will be invited to a short orientation: (elective). The orientation shows them how to use their ShareLife membership to get the most travel savings. In Las Vegas they come to our office for the orientation and to pick up the dining card and bonus trip voucher. Currently, if they choose to go to Orlando, the orientation is a short zoom meeting and the dining card and bonus voucher is subsequently emailed to them.
Upon completion of their orientation, they receive their $100 dining gift card, and their voucher for the bonus trip to their choice of 30 destinations.
There is no additional deposit or orientation involved in this Bonus trip.

Upon completion of their second vacation they receive their $100 deposit back. In Vegas, they get it in the form of a check at our offices, and at any of the other destinations, it will be mailed to them.
why: It's really that simple! This may sound too good to be true, but here's why hotels do this:
Hotels are filling up their rooms, and helping non-profits with an exciting, no obligation travel voucher. These vacations breed goodwill and translate into future engagement with the donors.
If a donor is not interested, they can gift it to a child, neighbor or friend…or simply discard it. These vouchers are to be used as a "Thank You" to your donors and not intended for sale.

faqs.question: Is this a time share presentation?
answer: No! This is a Free Basic Membership to ShareLife Travel, a travel savings private club, where members save $$$ above and beyond the nationally recognized sites you hear about everyday. In fact, they have a double the difference money-back guarantee backing up that claim.

faqs.question: How can we use these Vouchers?
answer: We have seen groups deploy these vouchers in many different ways, such as a "Thank You" for:
bullets: Sponsorships or Silent Auction Item donations

faqs.question: Is the ShareLife Vacations deposit required?
answer: Yes. It is required in order to get your Bonus Dining Gift Card and 2nd Bonus trip to over 30+ destinations. The deposit is truly just to make sure we don't pay for reserved rooms that go unused. Historically, there are a lot of no shows if we were to charge no deposit.

faqs.question: When do travelers get their $100 deposit refunded?
answer: Upon completion of their second trip, they will receive their deposit returned.

faqs.question: Do our guests automatically get the Bonus Gift Card and 2nd Vacation?
answer: No, not automatically. It is a Bonus for sitting thru the 12-15 minute orientation. Upon completion, they get both the Gift Card and an invitation for their second vacation which has an expanded destination list of 30 or so destinations

faqs.question: Do guests have to sit thru another orientation during their second vacation?
answer: No! There is no second orientation, and the list of destination cities is greatly expanded to 30+ destinations.

faqs.question: How long is the Orientation and can it be done virtually?
answer: The Orientation can be done in person, via Zoom or virtually as we have an automated interactive presentation that shows new guests how the membership works and what upgrades are available to them. The automated presentation takes roughly 12 minutes to view.

Our number one objective is to get our guests to use the platform to book their hotel stays instead of using Expedia or Travelocity. They get the guaranteed lowest price or double the difference back in cash.

faqs.question: Are you the one who emails the voucher to individuals? (i.e. do charities have to give you lists of their donors?)
answer: We (CharityWorks) prefer that your organization send the vouchers to individuals via e-delivery. We also have hard copy, full color 3x9 vouchers, but they cost something to print and deliver.

faqs.question: Are the Vouchers transferable?
answer: The vouchers are 100% transferable, and anybody such as family members, friends, neighbors, colleagues and/or associates may be given these vouchers.

faqs.question: Is there an expiration date on the Vouchers?
answer: The vouchers say that you should register within 30 days and book within a year. However, we will always honor them.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on these Vouchers?
answer: The only restriction is that these vouchers cannot be sold or used as Silent or Live auction items. They are a gift, or bonus to your fundraising initiatives.

faqs.question: Why do these properties do this?
answer: Properties fill rooms during the mid week and thus grow their occupancy levels. These guests eat, drink and in some cases gamble on the property, thus deriving derivative revenue streams from guests who are filling their rooms. They also cannot give away FREE rooms (they do have paying guests) so partnering with your charity to achieve these goals is a way in which they can do this, while supporting many great causes.

terms: Valid for two adults over 21 years of age only.
30 days advance booking required for reservations.

Transportation, incidentals and daily resort fees are not included.
Group travel is defined as multiple certificates being used by groups and/or related parties for concurrent or consecutive stays.
One-year travel window from your registration date
Deposit will be refunded in full upon completion of travel.
Dining Advantage Card and Bonus Trip Certificate to be issued at ShareLife Vacations Orientation.
